title.narrative: Establishment of a European Chamber of Commerce in Myanmar (ECCM)

description.narrative: This grant seeks to support the establishment of EuroChamber Myanmar in line with similar initiatives under the the EU Support to European Business in South-East Asia Markets (SEBSEAM). The objective is to increase and diversify exports and investment of EU businesses, in particular SMEs, to Myanmar, and to ASEAN.

title.narrative: R1 A membershipbased, independent, EU interestdriven and sustainable Chamber of Commerce is stablished

description.narrative: R1 A membershipbased, independent, EU interestdriven and sustainable Chamber of Commerce is stablished

title.narrative: Effective incorporation of the Chamber with European members contributing financially to the sustainability of the chamber.

description.narrative: Effective incorporation of the Chamber with European members contributing financially to the sustainability of the chamber.

comment.narrative: This baseline value is proposed by the RR expert in the absence of a baseline value in the project documentation.European parties are seeking guidance on how to establish themselves and penetrate a market that is opaque and full of inefficiencies. As such EuroCham building on the French Myanmar Chamber of Commerce FMCCI local expertise FMCCI has been present in Myanmar since 1995 will be able to provide advice to new entrants in particular SMEs which often do not have the resources to conduct market studies themselves. As EuroCham develops advocacy activities European companies will be able to bring to bear higher standards particularly in the area of sustainable development and environmental and conservation matters. This will allow Myanmar to attract the requisite of investment to ensure development in a country that remains one of the poorest in the world.source for the above pages 5 6 of Annex 1 Description of Action after Rider 1 ECCM
The final target is in the definition of the indicator.

Current value in December 2017.This current value is proposed by the RR expert because there is no summary of the value in the interim progress report. It is based on the extensive prose in the 3rd interim progress report pages 6 to 11.Following the agreement on the Articles of Association in December 2016 the registration process was launched early 2017 and finalized on June 5th 2017. Once EuroChams incorporation was completed the Business Development Department focused on selling its partnerships and its advocacy group memberships vital elements in EuroChams objective to reach sustainability. At the end of this years reporting period EuroCham counts 72 advocacy group members and 32 partner members. The chambers potential market for now is over 100 activeoperational European companies established in the national chambers. Once all MoUs with bilateral chambers are signed and in place their European members will become automatically Indirect Adherents of EuroCham Myanmar and we can reasonably estimate that at least half of them will eventually join EuroCham Myanmar services on Advocacy.

title.narrative: R2 Business Platform: relevant information on Myanmar legal regulatory framework and enforcement is Provided to European enterprises, especially SMEs, Market intelligence and guidance with officials and local business partners are provided. A website is set up

description.narrative: R2 Business Platform: relevant information on Myanmar legal regulatory framework and enforcement is Provided to European enterprises, especially SMEs, Market intelligence and guidance with officials and local business partners are provided. A website is set up

title.narrative: Updated first entry information made available on the website.

description.narrative: Updated first entry information made available on the website.

comment.narrative: This baseline value is proposed by the RR expert because it is the obvious baseline value.

The final target is equivalent to the definition of the indicator.Establishing a business platform in Myanmar implies that European companies especially SMEs are provided with relevant information on the Myanmar legal regulatory framework with regards to commercial activity. The EuroCham Myanmar website especially the Publication page is expected to provide a primary tool to offer first entry market information.Source for the above page 11 of Annex IV Interim Narrative Report December 13th 2016 to December 12th 2017

Status as at December 2017. Value proposed by RR expert.The publications of first entry information that serves as support to European SMEs business guide sectoral guides etc. were first made available in November 2016 and updated in December 2017. The Business Development Department will go on assisting the European SMEs with first entry level information upon demand and through online SME focussed readily available market entry information.The website includes the following sectionsInformation on EuroCham MyanmarPublications A business guide covering crucial questions on the business and investment climate in Myanmar 5 Sectoral Market Research Guides on respectively Energy Agriculture Manufacturing Health and Consumer Goods with entrylevel information for EU companies interested in investing in these sectors in Myanmar updated in December 2017.EuroCham Myanmar Business Confidence Survey 2017 Myanmar and ASEAN Intellectual Property Rights Information in collaboration with the SouthEast Asia IPR SME Helpdesk.A section dedicated to advocacy and the work of the advocacy groups with specific sections for the groups on AntiIllicit Trade Automotive CSR Digital Innovation Health Legal Energy Construction and Transport Logistics highlighting the mandates objectives and activities of each advocacy groups and the advantages of EuroChams advocacy services.A news section with updates on the business environment in Myanmar and activities of EuroCham and its partners.A dedicated membership section Sections covering EuroChams business promotion activities.

title.narrative: R4 Cross promotion: EU business with a special focus on SMEs are outreached

description.narrative: R4 Cross promotion: EU business with a special focus on SMEs are outreached

title.narrative: Number of events, conferences, trade shows, etc

description.narrative: Number of events, conferences, trade shows, etc

comment.narrative: By definition the baseline value is 0.

As per the logframe the yearly target is as follows 2 Road show Myanmar promotion events per year in EU to promote investment in Myanmar and outreach European companies.Note if the indicator was to be changed to include outreach events in Myanmar the target should be adjusted consequently.

Current value as of December 2017 8 events calculated by the RR expert based on the content of the 3rd interim progress report.Outreach in Europe 8 eventsEuroCham Myanmar was promoted by the affiliates of the project in Europe Brussels Paris Milan Antwerp and Budapest among others. A total of 8 visits to trade fairs in Europe via Eurochambres and the affiliated European entities. These events contributed to consolidate Myanmars position as an investment market for a number of potential European investors and EuroCham became known to European companies present in all these fairs and business gatherings.Outreach in Myanmar 2 27 events 29Visibility of EuroCham in Myanmar has been demonstrated in different ways. EuroCham Myanmar participated with a promotional area shared with other Chambers of Commerce present in Myanmar not only European but also with the Australian Chamber the American Chamber at the Myanmar Global Investment Forum in Nay Pyi Taw. Correspondingly EuroCham Myanmar was present at Euromoney in Nay Pyi Taw. EuroCham was also present in 27 local trade fairs.Source for the above Pages 26 27 of Annex IV Interim Narrative Report December 13th 2016 to December 12th 2017

title.narrative: SO2 Promote Myanmar as a highpotential trade partner , investment and gateway to ASEAN regional market

description.narrative: SO2 Promote Myanmar as a highpotential trade partner , investment and gateway to ASEAN regional market

title.narrative: Improved confidence of European investors in Myanmar as a trade and investment destination.

description.narrative: Improved confidence of European investors in Myanmar as a trade and investment destination.

comment.narrative: This baseline value is proposed by the RR expert based on the content of the 3rd interim progress report The second EuroCham Myanmar Business Confidence survey released on December 14th 2017 and hints at comparative figures with the year 2016 which could provide a baseline provided the indicator is better defined.
This is equivalent to the current definition of the indicator.

The current value December 2017 is proposed by the RR expert based on the comment below.The second EuroCham Myanmar Business Confidence survey released on December 14th 2017 shows that European companies are generally positive about the future for their businesses in Myanmar and the respondents believe that the country shows promise for the coming years and they are planning on reinvesting.However comparative figures with the year 2016 show that the business environment and the international image of Myanmar for foreign direct investors worsened and still needs improvements. European companies can support Myanmars difficult transition process by providing examples for standardisation in among others CSR safety regulations supporting inclusive economic development and sustainability.The results are effectively a signal for the government to continue the difficult work of changing Myanmar into a welcoming market for foreign direct investment. EuroCham Myanmar is determined to continue as a constructive partner to Myanmars government private sector development policy helping it to achieve its economic objectives.Source for the above Pages 4 5 of Annex IV Interim Narrative Report December 13th 2016 to December 12th 2017

description.narrative: SO3 Seek Positive and lasting change in domestic economic governance particularly with respect to the EU strategic priorities in the domain of sustainable development

title.narrative: Improved regulations taking into account the European values and in line with the EU strategic priorities and enforcement effectiveness.

description.narrative: Improved regulations taking into account the European values and in line with the EU strategic priorities and enforcement effectiveness.

comment.narrative: There is no baseline value proposed in the documentation.The above is a baseline value proposed by the RR expert.But the Description of the Action says page 3 Among the many issues that plague Myanmar and limit foreign investment limited knowledge of the law and uneven application and enforcement.
The final target is in the definition of the indicator.

Value for December 2017. This value is proposed by the RR expert based on the following content of the 3rd interim progress reportThe Government more and more business friendly and welcoming to FDIs has been making some considerable efforts to update important existing laws crucial to have a better trade and investment environment such as the Myanmar Companies Act 1914 MCA update that has been approved at the end of 2017 and to be implemented in August 2018 the Stateowned Economic Enterprises Law 1989 SOEE Law update the Myanmar Investment Law 2016 MIL the Myanmar Investment Rules 2017 MIR the Petroleum and Petroleum Product Law 2017 Petroleum Law the Environmental Conservation Law 2012 EC Law the environmental Impact Assessment Procedures 2015 EIA Procedures the Arbitration Law 2016 and the MIC notification 152017 Restricted Activities. Improvements are planned regarding the Foreign Employee Law Trade Mark Law Patent Law and Copyright Law that will be closely monitored by the recently created EuroCham Legal Advocacy Group.EuroCham with its Advocacy Groups is engaging with the government in order to help them with the design of the coming laws. EuroCham Myanmars five Advocacy Groups Energy Logistics Corporate Social Responsibility Health and Construction published in June 2017 the very first White Book highlighting key issues recommendations and potential gains for the government. The White Book 2017 has been tremendously well received by the government and is now a reference for MM Policy Making. The six new Advocacy Groups Automotive AntiIllicit Trade Legal Wine Spirits Digital Innovation and Agrobusiness created between June and December 2017 will also be part of the 2018 White Book and have already started to meet high level government stakeholders in their respective fields. Source for the above Pages 5 6 of Annex IV Interim Narrative Report December 13th 2016 to December 12th 2017
